clauses.title: Hospital
clauses.text: Hospital means any institution registered with the local authorities for in-patient care with qualified doctors and nursing staff round the clock.

clauses.title: Sum insured
clauses.text: The Sum Insured under this policy is Rs. 10,00,000 per policy year on a floater basis.

clauses.title: Room rent
clauses.text: Room rent is payable up to the actual charges of a single private AC room.

clauses.title: Intensive care
clauses.text: Intensive Care Unit charges are payable at actuals.

clauses.title: Proportionate deduction
clauses.text: If the insured person occupies a room category higher than the eligible single private AC room, all associated medical expenses except pharmacy, consumables, implants and diagnostics shall be payable in the proportion that the tariff of the eligible room bears to the tariff of the room occupied.

clauses.title: Zone co-payment
clauses.text: A co-payment of 20% applies only to claims for treatment taken in a city of a higher zone than the zone of cover chosen.

clauses.title: Initial waiting period
clauses.text: Any illness within the first 30 days of the policy commencement is excluded, except accidents.

clauses.title: Specific waiting period
clauses.text: The following are excluded for the first 24 months of continuous coverage: cataract, hernia, joint replacement, gall bladder stones and kidney stones.

clauses.title: Pre-existing diseases
clauses.text: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage.

clauses.title: Claim intimation
clauses.text: Emergency hospitalisation must be intimated within 24 hours of admission.
